title: Use of metamodels for rapid discovery of narrow bandgap oxide photocatalysts.
summary: Stacking metamodels selected two active candidates and two negative controls for synthesis; measured hydrogen evolution distinguished the candidates from the controls.
organization: RMIT University; Shinshu University; The University of Tokyo
